description: Monitor public APIs and detect breaking changes by diffing OpenAPI specs and classifying changelogs — a radar for the APIs you depend on. Use when you need early warning before an API change breaks your integration. Returns change events classified by severity. Pricing: $0.50 per run + $0.005 per API checked.

apis.description: List of APIs to watch. For type 'openapi', url must point to a raw OpenAPI spec (JSON or YAML). For type 'github-releases', url must be 'owner/repo' or a GitHub repo URL. For type 'rss', url must be an RSS/Atom changelog feed.

owner.description: Team or person responsible for this API on your side — copied into output events for routing.
owner.title: Owner (optional)

type.description: openapi = OpenAPI spec diffed with oasdiff (most precise). github-releases = GitHub releases classified by rules. rss = RSS/Atom changelog feed classified by rules.
type.title: Source type

url.description: Raw spec URL, 'owner/repo', or feed URL.
url.title: Source URL

apis.title: APIs to monitor

dryRun.description: When true, the actor performs the full detection but does NOT charge any pay-per-event fee. Use for testing your configuration.
dryRun.title: Dry run (no billing)

maxApis.description: Safety cap on the number of APIs processed in one run.
maxApis.title: Max APIs per run

webhookUrl.description: POST endpoint called at the end of each run with a JSON summary (counts by class + top critical changes). Slack/Discord/Teams incoming-webhook compatible payload is included.
webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (optional)

name: api_breaking_change_radar
